notes.title: Binary update 0.9.3
notes.content:
There were two major bugs in our track editor (ThunderShop)  basically creating new tracks or reloading textures produced a crash in the application.

We received really useful feedback from a user that plays with 8 controllers in the same PC. In that context the game is quite difficult to setup so we did all the changes we could in order to make it easier. As always game design isn't easy since there are many different use cases and some functionality contradicts or makes the use even worse, so we think we've found a balance in the changes and now the game should be easier to setup joysticks for 8 players.

These are the changes:
- Button mapping and player configuration won't be reseted with every new game version
- The first controller used will be the main controller
- In-game pause & camera change button can now be manually setted editing the file ./config/camera.cfg

Enjoy !

notes.title: Joystick bugfixing
notes.content:
We've recompiled our input library (OIS) and tested successfully with 5 Joysticks at the same time, so 8 Joysticks should now work again.

Also we found that in production the game behaves differently (buttons mapping changes) so we now have it working well out of the box and there is NO NEED to follow that "analog joystick" guide we've published some time ago.

Just leave the configuration on steam by default. Or just in case do this:
Steam->settings->controller->general controller settings and then click on the controllers you have connected to the pc.

Then in the library -> right click in thunderwheels -> properties... -> steam input per game -> "Use your global steam input settings".

That should be your default configuration any way.
If you can test the game with more than 4 controllers or if you have any question please post it here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/296790/discussions/0/1694969361100491125/#c1642052612836939495

notes.title: New version v0.8.18
notes.content:
New version 0.8.18 is out !

It has a new feature: car tuning
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30795117/092200f4f8bc272b659a8ff5245e96eae100e6ed.png[/img]

It can be used in all modes (championships and offline) and you can set:

[u]Driving help:[/u] [on/off] Affects anti-roll bars, rotation torque in the chassis to make the car turn faster and lowers mass center. Those are "helping measures" most of them affecting the steering. Now you will be able to turn it off!
[u]Steering:[/u] Controls how fast the wheels turns when you press keys or joystick buttons.
[u]Engine:[/u] Controls engine torque and maximum speed
[u]Susp. Hardness:[/u] Affects spring and damper suspension
[u]Susp. Height:[/u] Affects suspension travel and car height, also modifies how spring and damper works since a longer spring travel will produce a stronger total force in the car.

All default values are shown in yellow and once you modify one of them it will be shown in white. Each setting will be saved for each user & car so you can use it for example to make your "expert friend" drive a bit slower in Party Mode and level all the players so there isn't much difference between them (asked in the forums).

Also "Driving help" was mentioned in the forums, a player asked us to have some kind of "pro driving simulation". With this game it doesn't have any sense because it is an arcade ! and bumps + top-down view imposes many restrictions in how simulation is done because it could be really frustrating if it is too realistic, but now you can turn off the driving help if you want ;)

Also we're releasing a bugfix in the ThunderShop now v0.8.2, it will detect if the user didn't accepted Steam Subscriber Agreement, if you didn't your tracks will not visible in the community and the ThunderShop will give you a warning and a link to accept it.

Also we have a brand new [u]video tutorial showing how to create and upload a track to Steam Workshop[/u]:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1309208454

The video is in youtube with a small index in the footer if you are impatient or want to skip some parts.

Guys and gals new version 0.8.16 has been released :)

You can leave the game opened to test your tracks, every time you "restart" a race the track will be flushed/reloaded so all the changes you did in the editors will be shown in the game.

notes.title: Usability changes
notes.content:
Guys, our new version v0.8.7 is out, most of the changes are related to race end sequence and the possibility to skip waiting the time-out once a player ends the race and restart a competition in Championship mode without needing to go to main menu and then come back to the Championship.

This is the complete changelog for v0.8.7

+ Better engine sounds in top-down camera mode
+ Quit option is always on, so player can cancel races/session
+ Restart option is on in all championship modes except Multitrack Challenge
+ Pause menu will automatically skip time-out if a human player finished the race in all modes except Party
+ Different order in GUI buttons
+ Camera moved in end session to show winners podium better
+ Shortcut hack: Left Shift + P starts playing
+ Shortcut hack: Left Control + down assigns camera to ghost


Last two changes are helpful for spectator mode, it is a kind of hack because the game can crash if something is wrong in the CFG but it will let you play bypassing the screens. For example, if you set NO player and all ghosts, save thunderwheels.cfg, start the game and in the Main Menu you press:
Left Shift + P the game will start a race with the laps, tracks and ghosts you have written in the file without the need to have a local player (you).
Also you can make the camera follow a ghost pressing Left Control + down arrow.

Enjoy :)

notes.title: Ghosts feature completed :)
notes.content:
This is a [u]very very big update in terms of "playability"[/u] because now ghosts can win the race if you are not fast enough :)

As you know ghosts reproduce the hole race in Shootout and Endurance mode, well... now ghosts are treated like a local player in the game so they can win the race. After the race ends you have (as always) a time-out of 25 seconds to finish the race and your score is uploaded to the active Championship so it will not affect the way your score is submitted but you will be able to see your position in that race relative to other players.

It will be like racing 100% online but with some advantages: no collisions, no network lag, there is no need to be online at the same time, etc.

As before we download ghost with this logic:
- no scores yet ? no ghosts
- player didn't race in this category ? slower scores/ghosts are downloaded
- player has an score already ? download 2 faster and 5 slower ghosts

By downloading 2 faster racers, you have to try hard to get the same score you've submitted in order to be in the top 3 podium at the end of the race.

We've also added new assets: Reviens rev, Pecos Snow rev, more stripes skin textures for cars and some custom textures for the players that submitted their custom skins (Susiquiu, Javimod, Bike Man).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30795117/dbb9d7c35268957222bc79ebf36aa7f9571e55db.jpg[/img]

This is the change log for v0.8.6
[list]
[*] ghosts names changed when the player has the same name, now "g" is append at the end
[*] 5 seconds after race ends even if all players finished the race
[*] ghosts: better tuned distance on alpha
[*] ghosts: transparency for dust trail and racer name
[*] bugfix: engine sounds not turning off in hotlap mode
[*] bugfix: multitrack mode was uploading wrong ghosts
[*] ghosts_racers can now win races
[*] stripes in textures
[*] Reviens revert
[*] Pecos snow rev
[/list]

** Known bug: If you finish first you must wait until all ghosts finish.

Enjoy ;)

notes.title: Ghosts, experimental version
notes.content:
Hi everyone !

We have a new version (v0.8.4) with many small changes and the [b]*experimental version for ghosts*[/b] :)

This new version includes a highly asked feature, turn music on/off:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30795117/ca1ecaa237e59531dcb83681ff4626d85415cb89.jpg[/img]

So now you can disable background music and only listen effects sounds.
It also includes an improved timer so the scores sent in the championships will be much more exact.

And the most important feature, there is partial and *experimental* support for ghosts files. The game will now save you last race in a .ghost file here:

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\ThunderWheels\media\ghosts

The files have a naming convention: userid-trackname.ghost
I'm including my own ghost so you can test it right away: 76561198444366926-cabalango-test.ghost

Ghosts can be shared with anyone, just race one track (must finish all laps) and then go to the directory. The game will overwrite the last ghost so if you liked you race just rename it to avoid the game overwrite it the next time.

Ghost files contains the full race but currently only best lap is supported in the reproduction mode so if you share/play your ghost, the ghost will only reproduce the fastest lap in the recorded file.

How do I use the ghost ? easy, be sure to CLOSE THE GAME and open the configuration file:
\config\thunderwheels.cfg

look for this:
[code]
[main]

difficulty = 2
ghosts_hotlap =
ghosts_racers =
[/code]

And then add:
[code]
[main]

difficulty = 2
ghosts_hotlap = 76561198444366926-cabalango-test.ghost
ghosts_racers =
[/code]

That .ghost is the file I'm including, it should load an orange Wildcat Monster for the track Cabalango. Save the file, run the game, select one track in "Single play" mode, the track must by obviously "Cabalango".
The ghost should now appear in the race.

The tag ghosts_racers in the thunderwheels.cfg file is for the future once we implement more ghosts modes and is ignored right now.

You can play multiple ghosts files, just separate them with ; like this:

[code]
[main]

difficulty = 2
ghosts_hotlap = cabalango1.ghost;cabalango2.ghost;cabalango3.ghost
ghosts_racers =
[/code]

We also added a new feature in the ThunderShop, press '1' it switches to wireframe mode.

We hope you like this update :)

notes.title: Championships are now ready to play !
notes.content:
Yes ! Finally we finished the championships, it will be a regular competition with basic rules and we are going to compute global points for everyone playing.

How it works ?
There are 4 basics types of championships, the rules can be 
1- Hotlap: One track and the best lap is your score
2- Shootout: One track and the total race time is your score
3- Endurance: Same as shootout but the race is much longer
4- Multitrack: Compete in many different tracks, total season time is your score

Only #1 and #2 are included in the new version "Early access 0.8.3 " Endurance and Multitrack will come later ;)
Beside those simple rules some basic things are "forced" to make it funnier for example, Shootout mode right now is with 5 bots (maximum difficulty) all drivers using the same car, nitros enabled and only top-down camera is allowed :)

[b][u]Championships will have a start date and end date, each championship will be different with different rules and you can compete as many times you want while the championship is enabled.[/u][/b]

notes.title: Analog support for XBox controller
notes.content:
Hotfix: Proper support for analog joystick. Tested using XBox 360 wireless and PS3, using:
[b]Steam controller -> general configuration -> support for xbox controller
[set to disabled] this will let the game receive the controller input fully native.[/b]

Now the analog input is treated as analog and there is no interpolation over time in the input, so it is "really analog".

[u]By default the controller will work this way:[/u]
LT (analog) brakes
RT(analog) accelerator
Back button: game pause during the race
Right analog: Turns wheels (lower priority)
Left analog: Turns wheels (medium priority)
Hat (d-pad): Turns wheels (higher priority)

The game will react in priority order, we made that to avoid errors and input-fighting when analog joystick is just above DEAD-ZONE. Some generic controller have so little precision you wouldn't believe !
Please any comments are welcome ;)

Game version: Early Access v0.8.2

Happy weekend !
Luis.

notes.title: Update: Race ends when all drivers have finished
notes.content:
It wasn't easy since there is a lot of logic in the game affected but we do agreed with the players that it has to be changed and here is !

Build 2273324 changelog:

[list]
    [*]Last lap: "Hurry Up!" message
    [*]When there is a winner: "Race ended" message
    [*]When there is a winner: 20 seconds time out to finish the race or all racers reach the finish line.
    [*]When there is a winner: Each racer have a checker flag in the HUD
    [*]Added best lap time and current lap time (lower right corner) visible only in single-player mode
    [*]Improved sound cycling, fade-in, fade-out and performance hit on End Season screen.
[/list]

We love to improve and add features requested by users :)
